video_title: Cole Anthony & Joe Ingles: Melbourne United's big signings! EXCLUSIVE Aussie Hoops Hour chat! #NBL27

quotes.speaker: Cole Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Cole Anthony on the biggest adjustment to NBL basketball
quotes.excerpt: no defensive three seconds. Dudes just sitting in the paint, not moving, being lazy.

text_blocks.speaker: Cole Anthony
text_blocks.text: I would say that no defensive three seconds. Dudes just sitting in the paint, not moving, being lazy. That is probably the biggest difference.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: It is a different game, different rules.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on the physical nature of NBL defense
quotes.excerpt: the full court pressing of some teams. There is whatever two or three teams that are pretty heavy.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: The full court pressing of some teams. There is whatever two or three teams that are pretty heavy on the style of play of that. You are not getting anyone really. There might be one guy in every 10 or 15 games that might press a little bit in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on Cole Anthony's potential as an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: there is no question in my mind Cole is an NBA player.
quotes.quote: There is no question in my mind Cole is an NBA player. A lot of the time when I don't think people understand, I had the same situation. It is a big situational thing in the NBA. Finding the right organization, the right coach, the right GM, all those different things. There is no question in my mind Cole is an NBA player. Whether it is after this year or whatever time frame that is, Cole will be back in the NBA and he will be playing a big role on an NBA team.

quotes.speaker: Cole Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Cole Anthony on the value of Joe Ingles' experience
quotes.excerpt: he is a super high IQ player who just knows how to play, has a great feel.
quotes.quote: Playing in the NBA for 12 years, that is what his game is. He is a super high IQ player who just knows how to play, has a great feel. He is eight years older than Chancy, so he understands the game and we will talk. Ever since we were teammates in Orlando, he has been someone who is just always honest with me and kept it a buck, and I trust and value his opinion.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on the importance of aggressive scoring
quotes.excerpt: he told me go score the basketball. Don't hesitate, go do it.
quotes.quote: He told me go score the basketball. Don't hesitate, go do it. It is good advice, I am going to do that.

quotes.speaker: Cole Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Cole Anthony on Luke Travers' athletic potential
quotes.excerpt: he has an NBA type body. He is an athlete. He can guard one through five.
quotes.quote: He has an NBA type body. He is an athlete. His next thing is just showing how athletic he is, how he can play, how he can guard one through five. He can handle the rock. I think he is a guy who can genuinely go out there and do it all. Playing with dudes like me and Joe, putting him in a mid-ball screen and letting him get downhill with a head of steam, it is not really much you are going to be able to do about that.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on Luke Travers' defensive and offensive growth
quotes.excerpt: way better defender than I thought, way more athletic than I thought.
quotes.quote: His IQ is super high, way better defender than I thought, way more athletic than I thought. Offensively, his shot is really fluid. I think he has worked on that the last couple years in Cleveland. Putting all those things together and enhancing them a little bit more. Where the NBL is and NBA teams watching the NBL, he is going to be out there for a whole lot of those 40 minutes.
